name: SPI Pixels Channel Output
author: joeskolengaden
description: Drive clocked SPI pixel chips (APA102/SK9822/HD107S, HD108/SK9826, TLC59711, APA107, WS2801, LPD8806, LPD6803, P9813, SM16716) over /dev/spidev on a Raspberry Pi or BeagleBone. Adds an 'SPIPixels' channel output type.

privacy.summary: Drives LED chips over the board's SPI pins. It sends nothing over the network and collects nothing.

systemChanges.what: installs libfpp-co-SPIPixels.so into /usr/local/lib and runs ldconfig

privacy.other: Compiles on the device against the installed FPP headers; you must enable SPI on the board yourself.
